target.title: feat(gateway): add global auth rate limit mode for IP-agnostic brute-force protection
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When OpenClaw is deployed with `gateway.bind: "lan"` (or behind a reverse proxy exposing it to the public internet) and uses `gateway.auth.mode: "password"`, the current auth rate limiter only tracks failures per `{scope, clientIp}`. An attacker who can rotate IPs (proxy pools, botnets, cloud instances) gets a fresh counter for each IP, effectively bypassing the rate limit entirely.

This PR adds an optional `gateway.auth.rateLimit.global` flag that, when enabled, counts failed attempts across all client IPs in one shared counter per auth scope, so rotating-IP brute-force attacks cannot bypass the limiter.

Fixes #101255

## Why This Change Was Made

The implementation is minimal and opt-in:

- `RateLimitConfig` interface and `GatewayAuthRateLimitConfig` type: add `global?: boolean` (default `false`)
- `createAuthRateLimiter`: `resolveKey` drops the IP component when global mode is enabled, so all IPs share the same `${scope}` counter
- Zod schema: accept `global` in the strict rateLimit config object
- `exemptLoopback` still applies independently in global mode, so local CLI access is not affected by a remote attack triggering a global lockout

## User Impact

- **No existing behavior changes**: default remains `false` (per-IP tracking) for full backward compatibility
- Operators who set `global: true` get IP-agnostic brute-force protection for public-exposed deployments
- Tradeoff documented: a global bucket means a flood from any IP can lock out all clients for that auth scope

## Evidence

- `pnpm test src/gateway/auth-rate-limit.test.ts`: **172 passed** (existing 43×4 suites + 9 new global-mode test cases)
- New tests cover: shared counter across IPs, lockout propagation, scope isolation, loopback exemption, reset, maxEntries interaction, backward-compat default, and retryAfterMs for arbitrary IPs
- All 4 gateway test suites pass: `|gateway-core|`, `|gateway-server|`, `|gateway-client|`, `|gateway-methods|`
